import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_coal_production_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='table1', header=None)

ug_val = float(df.iloc[pa_idx + 1, 2])
surf_val = float(df.iloc[pa_idx + 2, 2])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_coal_production_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='table1', header=None)
subregions = ['Appalachia Central', 'Appalachia Northern', 'Appalachia Southern']

subset['prod_2024'] = subset[2].astype(float)
top2 = subset.sort_values(by='prod_2024', ascending=False).head(2)
result = top2[0].astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
